title: Q-BLIND-dependency-licences: close the ip blind spot dependency-licences
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every blindspots scan
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation blindspots --closed dependency-licences
**Prediction:** blindspots_open <= 7 within 168 h
**Status:** open

Why the owner would not know to ask: A dependency licence can forbid the commercial terms the product sells under.
Action: inventory dependencies and their licences and check against USL-1.0 commercial use. The probe in doctrine/blindspots.json passes when it is done.
